cards.title: Should you move closer to family before school?
cards.body: A parent dilemma about relocating near family for school readiness. While proximity offers support, building new friendships and community ties takes time and has real costs beyond finances.

cards.title: Adult son moving back home after graduation
cards.body: Many graduates are returning to the nest due to economic pressures, shifting family dynamics. Parents must navigate the transition from empty-nest independence back to active parenting.

cards.title: Leaving your family for adventure: ethical questions
cards.body: Some parents choose extreme adventures like wilderness survival or world travel, raising questions about parental responsibility. Is leaving small children acceptable in pursuit of personal goals?

cards.title: How to help children navigate emotions when stressed
cards.body: Parents can model healthy emotional responses while teaching kids problem-solving techniques. The Seven Shifts framework helps both parent and child learn emotion regulation together.

cards.title: End homework battles: getting kids started on schoolwork
cards.body: Simple strategies help children take ownership of assignments and stay organized. Moving beyond daily conflicts creates independence and reduces parental frustration.

cards.title: How to stop sexual violence begins in childhood
cards.body: Ending sexual violence requires education and awareness starting early. Children need age-appropriate guidance on boundaries, consent, and healthy relationships.

cards.title: Horses help children learn emotion regulation
cards.body: Equine therapy helps children recognize and manage their emotional responses through mirroring. Horses provide immediate, non-judgmental feedback that supports emotional development.

cards.title: Healthy families make room for different grief experiences
cards.body: Family members often grieve differently after loss, and accepting these differences strengthens bonds. Distance doesn't diminish love when families understand grief is individual.

cards.title: Prince George's artwork featured in Country Life
cards.body: The Prince of Wales shares his 13-year-old son's bird drawing in a special magazine edition. The feature celebrates children's artistic expression and creativity.

cards.title: Stickers and building sets drive pre-Christmas toy sales
cards.body: Traditional toys are outselling tech this holiday season amid screen time concerns. Building sets and creative play remain popular choices for child development.
